parts.html: The K-03 kitchen model combines dramatic black surfaces, warm wood-effect textures, and clean contemporary lines to create a distinctive kitchen interior.
Its straight-line configuration with a separate kitchen island offers a functional arrangement that balances minimalist aesthetics with practical everyday use.

The contrast between the dark cabinet surfaces and the natural appearance of wood-effect finishes adds visual depth to the kitchen. This combination makes the K-03 model suitable for contemporary apartments, open-plan living spaces, and modern private residences.
The upper cabinet fronts are manufactured from HPL panels on an MDF substrate, while the lower cabinet fronts feature laminated particleboard construction.
A porcelain stoneware countertop complements the kitchen's architectural appearance and provides a practical surface for everyday food preparation.
With a total linear length of 7 meters, the main kitchen configuration offers space for integrated appliances, cabinet storage, and organized cooking areas.
The kitchen island creates an additional functional surface and helps define the kitchen area within an open-plan interior.

For everyday convenience, the model includes Hettich soft-close hinges and Atira Hettich drawer systems. These components support smooth cabinet operation and comfortable access to kitchen essentials.
Cabinet handles are included, and the main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
Upper cabinet fronts: HPL panels on MDF substrate
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential properties in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-03 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance specifications, storage requirements, and architectural features.
Our approach combines customized furniture planning with material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional kitchen installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's preferences.
Order your K-03 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a contemporary living space where bold design meets everyday functionality.
